title: Highlights of Sri Lanka: Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Yala and Bentota
alt: Peacock displaying on the track in Yala National Park
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide; 4x4 jeep for the Yala safari

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Hilltop hotel with a pool looking down on Kandy

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Upper lake drive and Kandyan dance performance
activities.description: An evening circuit of the upper lake road, then the drummers, masked dancers and fire walkers.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: One night above Kandy with the elephants on the way and the upper lake drive and dance show.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Hill country hotel among the tea bushes above Nuwara Eliya

activities.name: Nuwara Eliya sightseeing tour
activities.description: Gregory Lake, Victoria Park, a tea estate and the colonial town.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: Up into the tea country for a night among the bushes with a tour of the town, its lake and gardens.

stops.name: Yala
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class lodge on the edge of Yala National Park

activities.name: Jeep safari in Yala National Park
activities.description: A 4x4 safari through the scrub jungle and lagoons of block one, home to leopards, sloth bears, elephants and crocodiles.

program.name: Yala
program.description: Across the hills to the dry south east for a jeep safari in Yala and a night on the edge of the park.

stops.name: Bentota

activities.description: The hatchery where eggs are protected and hatchlings released into the sea at dusk.

activities.name: Evening on the Madu River
activities.description: A late afternoon boat through the mangroves as the birds come home to roost.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: West along the coast for the turtle hatchery, an evening on the Madu River and a night by the sea.

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Yala at dawn is the single best morning you can have in Sri Lanka. Leopards are shy, but the elephants and peacocks never disappoint.
expert.tip: Wear neutral colours for the safari and keep the camera ready at the waterholes. The first hour after the gates open is when the cats move.

summary: Six days that touch every side of the island: a night in Kandy with the elephants and the dance show, a night in the tea country, a jeep safari and a night at Yala, the turtles and the Madu River at Bentota, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 5 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast daily (dinner also at Yala); private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary; the upper lake drive and Kandyan dance performance; the Nuwara Eliya sightseeing tour; a jeep safari in Yala National Park; the Kosgoda turtle hatchery; an evening on the Madu River; Colombo sightseeing and Pettah.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; Yala park entrance ticket; lunches and dinners unless stated; entrance tickets elsewhere; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
